architect.reply:
Yes

The design is sound, minimal, and cleanly enforceable. Requiring input encoding coverage in the corpus and neighbour variants prior to red directly closes the structural blind spots exposed during card 441 review rounds. Specifying concrete variant dimensions (separators, escapes, case, and one-letter forms) provides objective criteria that prevent arbitrary findings or checker false positives. Bound to D263's trial with a 15-minute slice counter-metric, it introduces minimal process overhead while ensuring architectural robustness across input representations.

CITE: the corpus also holds at least one row for each input encoding the function will meet
